patterns.note: The site uses a dark-mode dominant layout with high contrast white text and a centered content column, providing ample negative space around key information.
Headings feature large, bold, and widely-spaced sans-serif typography, creating a strong visual hierarchy and modern aesthetic.
A vibrant electric blue is used as a primary accent color for calls-to-action, links, and key interactive elements, standing out against the dark monochrome background.
Sections are revealed with a subtle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scrolling experience.
The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid background color after the initial hero section passes.
Client logos are presented in a horizontally scrolling or grid-like section that appears dynamically as the user scrolls down the page.

technique_notes: Sections are animated into view using scroll-triggered CSS keyframes, applying a subtle vertical translation and opacity change to reveal content as it enters the viewport.

The global navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that dynamically adjusts its padding and background color via CSS transitions when the scroll position changes, creating a compact, persistent header.
Interactive elements like buttons and links utilize a distinct blue accent color for their primary state and a slightly darker blue for hover, providing clear visual feedback.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, and widely-spaced display headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, legible body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and card containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a high-contrast dark theme, combined with large, impactful typography and a vibrant electric blue accent, creates a sophisticated and modern feel that avoids generic marketing aesthetics. The subtle scroll-triggered animations enhance engagement without being distracting.
